svg.title: Throughput by workload
svg.desc: and: sift 12,114, sift (positions off) 12,166, pg_search 2,193, pg_textsearch 75, rum 2,266, pgx-bm25 76, Elasticsearch 4,955; or: sift 3,858, sift (positions off) 3,705, pg_search 1,585, pg_textsearch 3,982, rum 24, pgx-bm25 59, Elasticsearch 2,895; phrase: sift 10,631, sift (positions off) 2,661, pg_search 2,097, pg_textsearch 92, rum 68, pgx-bm25 42, Elasticsearch 5,678; mixed: sift 6,987, sift (positions off) 4,420, pg_search 1,926, pg_textsearch 88, rum 41, pgx-bm25 50, Elasticsearch 4,449; count(*): sift 14,191, sift (positions off) 3,222, pg_search 2,084, pg_textsearch 121, rum 83, pgx-bm25 48, Elasticsearch 8,144; filter: sift 5,851, sift (positions off) 4,958, pg_search 1,818, pg_textsearch 87, rum 47, pgx-bm25 51, Elasticsearch 3,705; join: sift 2,745, sift (positions off) 1,757, pg_search 366, pg_textsearch 80, rum 43, pgx-bm25 47, Elasticsearch 5,024
svg.text: queries per second, higher is better
Error bars: one standard error over the interleaved rounds (rough for 2-3); red: relative error above 10%.
Elasticsearch: a JVM server over HTTP; its join is a term filter on a denormalized region field.
Simple English Wikipedia, 50,000 articles, 8 clients, median of 2-3 rounds; AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, 16 threads (load avg 7-9); Oct 2026.
